sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sharply exasperated and incredulous, with a burst of frustrated panic at how unfairly her already-bad first morning is going.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s impatient and stressed, urgently trying to push through the delay while barely holding back her frustration about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to talk herself into staying upbeat, but underneath the joking tone she feels flustered, stressed, and embarrassed about already being in a mess on the first day.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and urgently determined, pushing through the crowd with embarrassed energy while trying to stay upbeat and not let the bad start rattle her.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Breathless and relieved after a frantic rush, with a burst of triumphant optimism that she’s finally arrived despite the chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward realization, her confident rush collapsing into a small, startled pause as she registers that she has walked into the wrong room.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from realizing she may have rushed into the wrong classroom, but she’s trying to recover quickly and sound composed.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and flustered, but covering it with bright, sarcastic self-mockery to keep from looking embarrassed in front of everyone.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from the mistaken classroom entrance, but trying to recover with upbeat politeness and a determined, socially confident front.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with her embarrassment turning into playful, breathless relief as she leans on Mika’s help to recover her confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from her string of mistakes, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-deprecating energy and a determined eagerness to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but now mostly relieved and amused at her own disastrous morning, with a lingering sense of disbelief and self-deprecating frustration.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing it off with self-deprecating humor, trying to turn a mortifying mistake into a playful story and keep her spirits up.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful self-assurance and trying to frame the whole mess as a funny win instead of a humiliating mistake.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and warmly embarrassed, but is turning that shared awkwardness into an upbeat, friendly bid for companionship and reassurance.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness
